system.description:
Deal [2D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target. Secondary targets within a range of [Target: Area (P) / Range: Close] centered on yourself regain [(Recovery) + (SRx3)] HP.

The act of wielding a weapon is likened to the movement of forging, which is a symbol of creation, creating a healing power, and a special skill that heals the wounds of surrounding allies along with the attack.
